title: A Letter to the Bank
text:
Dear Mr. Brown, I am writing about my bank account. Last week, I received a letter with a wrong address. I would like you to correct it as soon as possible.

Please send me a new card at the same address. I also need a copy of my statement for May. Thank you for your help. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours sincerely, Anna Smith.

questions.text: Why is the writer writing to the bank?
options: Because a letter had a wrong address
Because she wants to close her account
Because she lost her bank card
Because she wants to ask for a loan

questions.text: What does the writer need for May?
How does the writer feel about the bank's help?
Why does the writer use 'Dear' and 'Yours sincerely'?
options: Because this is a formal letter
Because she is writing to a friend
Because this is a text message

vocabulary.definition: an official document that lists the money paid in and out of an account
to change something so that it is right
got something that was sent to you

paragraph_translations: Шановний пане Браун, я пишу вам щодо мого банківського рахунку. Минулого тижня я отримала лист з неправильною адресою. Будь ласка, виправте її якомога швидше.
Будь ласка, надішліть мені нову картку за тією самою адресою. Мені також потрібна копія моєї виписки за травень. Дякую за допомогу. Чекаю на вашу відповідь. З повагою, Анна Сміт.
